lead: Writing a tree file through Python's text mode rewrites every line ending on this checkout.
body: `Path.read_text` maps `\r\n` to `\n` and `write_text` writes back what it was handed, so a one-word change reports every touched file modified with an empty `git diff`, buries the real change in `git status`, and makes a "restore the original bytes" rollback a lie. Open with `newline=""` in both directions.
